scene.description: Same-parameter comparison branch: identical high-risk scenario with timestep-level micro-settlement/checking after every unit credit step.

rendering.node_color: net worth color scale; current/default nodes override to red/orange
rendering.node_size: debt pressure relative to cash plus loan assets
rendering.cascade_highlight: incoming exposures to the node being cleared are red
rendering.legend: drawn in the lower-right corner of each frame and keyframe panel

seed_selection.criterion: Choose a visual demonstration seed, within the fixed high-risk same-parameter scenario, where period_end reaches the 10%N large-event threshold and timestep_settle_check remains below that threshold. This is not a global statistical conclusion.

same_params_comparison.common_layout: shared spring layout built from both protocol traces
same_params_comparison.common_color_scale: shared scale built from both protocol traces
same_params_comparison.only_intended_protocol_difference: default_check_mode and resulting settlement/check granularity: period_end versus timestep_settle_check
